data.description: Wave 2, depends on the dispatcher extraction. SPEC IDs: RES-1..RES-5. Metric-driven: 10+ live conversations, 3+ workspaces, 3+ kinds (claude-code + codex + one of pi/omp/opencode), kill -9, relaunch; every conversation resumes per its declared tier or shows an honest diagnostic_reason; zero silent fresh-launches. Wire the pull-scrape rail and whatever else the scenario requires; nothing it does not. Scenario encoded as a repeatable harness runnable by delegator, validator, and CI. Clean-shutdown resume must not regress. references/conversation.md updated in same PR. Contract: docs/cycles/2026-07-truth-and-stability/ (SPEC.md, EVALUATION.md, BUILDPLAN.md). Validation bar: tagged build + recorded scenario proof.
data.title: Crash-resume completion: force-kill scenario as the acceptance gate

data.note: Wave 2 builds on the extracted dispatcher base

data.body: Plan posted (planned). Cold read of main found the crash-resume machinery is already merged (C11-131 crash fix + state/app CLI + session.save; C11-151..154 exact resume for opencode/pi/omp; C11-152 pull-scrape rail wired into live restore; reclassifyAfterCrash + ShutdownSentinel). So C11-164 is a completion + acceptance gate, not a greenfield build, and RES-2 governs: build the multi-kind force-kill harness first (≥10 conversations / ≥3 workspaces / ≥3 kinds = claude-code + codex + pi + omp; opencode excluded — its scraper isn't registered and pi/omp satisfy the +1 clause), run it on a tagged build, and close exactly the gaps the red rows surface. Two gaps are pre-identified and named in RES-2: SurfaceActivityTracker snapshot persistence (seed/snapshot exist but are dead code) and Codex cwd recovery (the cwd filter is a structural no-op). Both wired only if the scenario demonstrates the need; a scope-trace artifact maps each subsystem touched to the scenario row that required it. RES-4 anchored by keeping the existing claude-only e2e + Swift suites green; RES-5 rewrites references/conversation.md (currently stale — it still calls pull-scrape a v1.1 follow-up) + skill sync. Flagged seam: TEL also touches SurfaceActivity/SessionPanelSnapshot — keeping the activity field additive/namespaced for a clean merge. Awaiting triple plan-review, then awaiting-resume.

Plan-review outcome + one escalation for the orchestrator.

BOARD PLAN-REVIEW INFRA FAILURE: the auto triple plan-review could not spawn — its c11 panes failed with 'pane_too_small' (won't split pane:57 below the 640x340 min) in the orchestrator workspace (DB29BC45). Retried headless, same geometry failure. This is infra, not a plan defect. I ran an own-reviewer fallback instead: two independent headless reviewers (technical/eng + scope/acceptance). Their findings were substantive and are triaged into an AUTHORITATIVE amendment block (plan §9). Net material changes for the resume phase: (1) store-state oracle (conversation list --json state + diagnostic_reason with auto-resume disabled) NOT shim-argv resume-keystroke — the existing C11-131 harness proved the keystroke isn't shim-interceptable on restored panes; (2) adversarial fixtures required (>=1 same-cwd codex pair + stale/fresh session files) and the fix-gating default inverted to 'ship G2/G3 unless the harness disproves the need' — clean single-session fixtures would false-green the exact bug this cycle exists to kill; (3) Codex real-cwd recovery (G3) treated as effectively required, not conditional, because CodexScraper stamps the querying surface's cwd on every candidate so concurrent codex sessions all read as ambiguous; (4) G2 needs a contexts(from:) thread-through (it hardcodes lastActivityTimestamp:nil today) + a CodingKeys entry on SessionPanelSnapshot + a non-nil round-trip assertion, else it's a silent no-op.

ESCALATION (R5, needs an orchestrator decision before both PRs open): TEL (ticket 4) and RES (ticket 6) both add an activity field to SessionPanelSnapshot / touch SurfaceActivityTracker, and both stop at pr_open without merging. 'RES consumes TEL's field if it lands first' is unactionable when neither merges autonomously — the operator inherits a double-definition on the second merge. Request: one shared field name + single writer + a named owner for the post-merge reconciliation commit. Until then RES uses a RES-namespaced key and records the open coordination item in the PR body. Proceeding to awaiting-resume.

Plan revalidated against merged main (16c9c2d2a, C11-159 landed). All anchors confirmed in the worktree: reclassifyAfterCrash wired at AppDelegate:3328, scrape-capture at 3277-3282, seedFromSnapshot at 3266; ScrapeCaptureContext.contexts(from:) at line 34 builds contexts WITHOUT lastActivityTimestamp (always nil at restore — confirms the R4 G2 wiring gap: persistence is a no-op unless contexts(from:) is threaded); SessionPanelSnapshot has an explicit CodingKeys enum at :355 (confirms the R4 CodingKeys trap); SurfaceActivity seed/snapshot exist as dead code. No architectural drift — the §9 amendment block stands. Moving to in_progress.

Impl milestone: G2 (SurfaceActivity snapshot persistence) + G3 (Codex real-cwd recovery via bounded allowlisted rollout-header read) landed with Tier-1 tests all green on c11-logic; existing conversation/resume logic suites (45 tests) still green — RES-4 no regression. Multi-kind acceptance harness (tests_v2/test_crash_resume_multikind_e2e.py + crash_resume_support.py) authored: >=12 conversations / >=4 workspaces / 4 kinds (claude-code+codex+pi+omp), adversarial same-cwd codex pair + stale/fresh pi pair, store-state oracle. references/conversation.md rewritten to post-cycle truth + skill synced (RES-5). 3 commits on ts/res-crash-resume. Next: tagged build (res-post) + record the kill-9 scenario proof — currently queued on the xcodebuild lock (both slots held by evt+cor). Note: host c11Tests target has pre-existing local-toolchain compile errors (TerminalAndGhosttyTests 'trigger' arg, SurfaceActivityTests optional-accuracy) unrelated to this ticket — identical to origin/main, CI-green there; my scraper Tier-1 tests were placed in c11-logic so they run in the fast gate + CI.

Re: COR host-lane flag (SurfaceActivityTests). Confirmed it's a REAL universal Swift break (not local-toolchain): XCTAssertEqual(Date?.timeIntervalSince1970, Double, accuracy:) — the accuracy overload requires non-optional FloatingPoint. Fixed in this PR (commit b56cf221f) via XCTUnwrap; in scope because SurfaceActivityTracker.seed/snapshot round-trip — what that file tests — is now load-bearing for G2. HOWEVER the host lane has a SECOND, orthogonal pre-existing break I hit but did NOT fix (out of RES scope): c11Tests/TerminalAndGhosttyTests.swift calls TerminalWindowPortalRegistry.scheduleExternalGeometrySynchronizeForAllWindows() WITHOUT the now-required 'trigger:' arg at lines 2238/2296/2389/2468/2613 (the method signature is scheduleExternalGeometrySynchronizeForAllWindows(trigger: String), no default). So my fix unblocks the SurfaceActivity file but the c11-unit lane will still fail to compile until the terminal-geometry test is updated by its owner. Flagging so the operator/orchestrator can route that one.

Code review complete (own-reviewer fallback — the lattice code-review saw an empty working-tree diff because all work is committed; ran an independent reviewer on origin/main..HEAD instead). Verdict: all Swift changes CLEARED — G2/G3 logic, the candidates(cwd:recoverCwd:) overload + protocol conformance, readSessionHead safety, the additive lastActivityAt field, and the SurfaceActivityTests fix. The store-state oracle was confirmed to catch regressions (a G3 cwd-recovery regression would collapse distinct-cwd codex into ambiguity and fail the '>=1 codex RESOLVED' gate — i.e. no false-green), with no operator-session-damage path (kill guarded by PROC_TOKEN, teardown only removes run-scoped files). Two harness findings, both false-RED (flakiness) only: (1) per-scenario READY-baseline reset — FIXED (635aa2dba); (2) shared run_dir fixture accumulation — NIT, confirmed safe by the claim-time floor, left as-is. No blockers.

COMPLETE — at pr_open, PR #321 (https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/321). Operator merges (Wave 2 barrier).

WHAT SHIPPED (7 commits on ts/res-crash-resume): the crash-resume machinery was already merged (C11-131 + C11-151..154); this closes the two gaps RES-1's scenario requires — G2 (SurfaceActivityTracker snapshot persistence: last_activity_at on SessionPanelSnapshot, seeded at restore, threaded into the restore-time scrape) and G3 (Codex real-cwd recovery via a bounded, allowlisted rollout-header read — distinct-workspace codex now resumes, same-cwd pairs stay honestly ambiguous) — plus the multi-kind kill-9 acceptance harness (RES-3) and the references/conversation.md rewrite + skill sync (RES-5).

EVIDENCE (attached --role validation): RES-1 acceptance RECORDED — full harness run 49/0: 10 RESOLVED / 2 honestly-ambiguous (the adversarial same-cwd codex pair) / 0 FAIL across all 4 kinds (claude-code+codex+pi+omp), pi floor test resolves, all 5 scenario variants green. RES-4: 45 existing conversation-resume logic tests green + 17 new Tier-1 green; final-build single-pane E2E proves the runtime pipeline. Own-reviewer cleared all Swift; 1 harness finding fixed, 1 NIT safe.

TWO FLAGS FOR THE OPERATOR:
1. RES-3 twice-green: the FIRST full run is green (49/0, recorded). The SECOND consecutive run was blocked in-session by a LOCKED macOS screen (CGSSessionScreenIsLocked=True) — a locked session restricts the window server so the tagged GUI can't materialise workspaces (ready=0); NOT a code/harness defect (single-pane E2E passed on the final build while unlocked). The harness now aborts up front on a locked screen. Reconfirm trivially with screen unlocked: caffeinate -d -i python3 tests_v2/test_crash_resume_multikind_e2e.py (twice).
2. Host lane: fixed the C11-165/COR-flagged SurfaceActivityTests break (in scope). A SEPARATE orthogonal pre-existing break remains — TerminalAndGhosttyTests.swift calls scheduleExternalGeometrySynchronizeForAllWindows() without the required trigger: arg (5 sites) — out of RES scope, needs its owner; c11-unit won't fully compile until that's fixed too.

Also flagged earlier (R5): TEL and RES both touch SessionPanelSnapshot/SurfaceActivity — RES used a namespaced field (last_activity_at) additively; whoever merges second may need a trivial reconcile. STOP — awaiting operator merge.

Review basis for done: merged to main via GitHub PR (#321) after delegator inline review + drawbridge-review CI green; C4 Result Validator audited GREEN (0 Fail/0 Blocked). Attaching review role to satisfy completion policy — status reflects merged reality.
